title: Hobo Craft SMP
description: This modpack is created to be used in the Hobo Craft SMP.
body:
Hobo Craft is a vanilla-focused SMP modpack made for players who love the classic Minecraft experience but with a few extra touches to make life easier. This pack keeps the core survival gameplay completely intact — no crazy overhauls, no complicated tech, just the same Minecraft you know and love with some quality-of-life improvements.

You’ll find small but meaningful changes that improve the way you play, such as better performance and cleaner interfaces. Features like minimaps and smoother gameplay tweaks make survival more enjoyable while keeping everything familiar.

The goal of Hobo Craft is to enhance the multiplayer experience. Nothing gets in the way of community builds, adventuring with friends, or surviving together. It’s lightweight, beginner-friendly, and designed to run smoothly so everyone can hop in and start playing without hassle.

Whether you’re grinding for resources, building massive bases, or just hanging out with the server community, Hobo Craft gives you a polished vanilla+ experience. Perfect for players who want Minecraft to feel fresh and fun, without losing the charm of the original game.
